001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007import java.util.Arrays;
008
009/**
010 * The response the pump sent to a DismissNotificationRequest (an alert, alarm or reminder
011 * acknowledgement sent over Bluetooth), written immediately after the request's history log
012 * (opcode 290, requestOpCode 184) in 591/591 records across the Trio/TandemKit logs and the
013 * official-app captures. It has the same layout as the generic control-response record (opcode
014 * 300, jwoglom/pumpx2#145); the pump logs DismissNotification answers under their own opcode.
015 *
016 * <p>In the Trio/TandemKit logs there is exactly one of these per DismissNotificationRequest the
017 * app sent (348/348 and 102/102 on two Mobi pumps). {@code responseOpCode} is 185
018 * (DismissNotificationResponse) in every record.
019 *
020 * <p>The class name is provisional: Tandem's cloud export and the Mobi app's HistoryLogType enum
021 * do not name this opcode. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/147.
022 */
023@HistoryLogProps(
024    opCode = 334,
025    displayName = "Dismiss Notification Response",
026    internalName = ""
027)
028public class DismissNotificationResponseHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
029
030    private int responseOpCode;
031    private int unknown11;
032    private int status;
033    private byte[] unknownTail;
034
035    public DismissNotificationResponseHistoryLog() {}
036    public DismissNotificationResponseHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int responseOpCode, int unknown11, int status, byte[] unknownTail) {
037        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
038        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, responseOpCode, unknown11, status, unknownTail);
039        this.responseOpCode = responseOpCode;
040        this.unknown11 = unknown11;
041        this.status = status;
042        this.unknownTail = Arrays.copyOfRange(this.cargo, 13, 26);
043    }
044
045    public DismissNotificationResponseHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int responseOpCode, int status) {
046        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, responseOpCode, 0, status, new byte[13]);
047    }
048
049    public DismissNotificationResponseHistoryLog(int responseOpCode, int status) {
050        this(0, 0, responseOpCode, status);
051    }
052
053    public int typeId() {
054        return 334;
055    }
056
057    /**
058     * <table border="1">
059     * <caption>Parsed fields for DismissNotificationResponseHistoryLog:</caption>
060     * <tr><td><code>responseOpCode</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>unknown11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>status</code></td><td><code>raw[12] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>unknownTail</code></td><td><code>Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 13, 26)</code></td></tr>
064     * </table>
065     */
066    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
067        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
068        this.cargo = raw;
069        parseBase(raw);
070        this.responseOpCode = raw[10] & 0xFF;
071        this.unknown11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
072        this.status = raw[12] & 0xFF;
073        this.unknownTail = Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 13, 26);
074    }
075
076    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int responseOpCode, int unknown11, int status, byte[] unknownTail) {
077        Validate.isTrue(unknownTail.length == 13, "unknownTail must be 13 bytes");
078        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
079            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(334, 0),
080            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
081            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
082            new byte[]{ (byte) responseOpCode, (byte) unknown11, (byte) status },
083            unknownTail));
084    }
085
086    /**
087     * The opcode of the response the pump sent, as an unsigned byte (the pumpX2 response
088     * {@code opCode} ANDed with 0xFF). Always 185, DismissNotificationResponse, in the records
089     * examined (591 records on four pumps).
090     *
091     * @return the unsigned opcode of the response
092     */
093    public int getResponseOpCode() {
094        return responseOpCode;
095    }
096
097    /**
098     * The status byte of the DismissNotificationResponse: 0 on success. Every nonzero value that
099     * could be checked against live traffic (four records on three pumps) matched a
100     * DismissNotificationResponse reporting status 1, e.g. the second of two alarm dismissals the
101     * app sent in the same second.
102     *
103     * @return the response status, 0 for success
104     */
105    public int getStatus() {
106        return status;
107    }
108
109    /**
110     * @return byte 11, which was 0 in every record examined
111     */
112    public int getUnknown11() {
113        return unknown11;
114    }
115
116    /**
117     * @return a copy of bytes 13-25, which were zero in every record examined
118     */
119    public byte[] getUnknownTail() {
120        return Arrays.copyOf(unknownTail, unknownTail.length);
121    }
122}
